details: Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced substantial outflows, totaling $265 million over the past 24 hours. This significant capital movement indicates a bearish sentiment among investors, occurring amidst ongoing discussions about the potential market influence of Ethereum.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See $265M Outflows in 24 Hours

details: Ethereum (ETH) witnessed a 2.27% price increase in 24 hours, fueled by global liquidity shifts and dovish expectations for the Federal Reserve. Institutional inflows into spot ETFs are tightening supply. However, potential delays in the SEC's approval of S-1 registration statements for spot Ethereum ETFs could introduce market uncertainty and "sell-the-news" pressure, potentially leading to immediate institutional inflow delays and concerns over Grayscale Ethereum Trust (ETHE) outflows.
title: Ethereum Rises 2.27% Amid Liquidity Shifts; ETF S-1 Delays Loom

details: Avalanche (AVAX) experienced a 5% decline in value as the wider crypto market entered a risk-off phase. This drop is primarily attributed to a general market de-risking trend and AVAX's characteristic high beta, rather than any specific negative news or ecosystem developments concerning the asset itself.
title: Avalanche (AVAX) Drops 5% in Broader Market De-Risking

details: KAITO saw a significant 6.91% surge over 35 hours, largely driven by the successful launch of its Katalyst product on July 29, 2026, and its increasing relevance within the "AI on Base" sector. The Katalyst launch is expected to provide a clearer mechanism for value accrual for KAITO stakers.
title: KAITO Surges 6.91% Following Katalyst Launch and AI Narrative

details: Audiera (BEAT) recorded a 22% price increase to $4.60 within 24 hours. This surge appears to be primarily fueled by intense social media hype, a related trading contest, and narratives surrounding whale outflows, with no underlying fundamental news detected to support the rally.
title: Audiera (BEAT) Jumps 22% Driven by Social Media Hype

details: A recent decree has officially prohibited cryptocurrency mining activities across the Moscow region and specified areas of Kursk. This ban has been enacted to address and mitigate concerns regarding the stability and overall capacity of the local power grid.
title: Moscow & Kursk Regions Ban Crypto Mining Citing Power Concerns

details: Bitwise has initiated the liquidation of six of its crypto option Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs). These particular ETFs were known for offering 25% payouts, and the firm is now in the process of returning the invested capital to its investors.
title: Bitwise Liquidates Six Crypto Option ETFs, Returns Capital
